description: Close a RankFuel leaderboard when the contest ends: the public board shows final standings and no more points can be added. Pass reopen: true to reopen. Needs the SECRET manage token. Free, no key.

boardId.description: Leaderboard id (10 characters) or its public link, e.g. https://rfwin.uk/lb/abc123defg

manageToken.description: SECRET manage token (rlb_…) returned once by create_leaderboard (the manage link also works). Keep private; never show it in public places.

reopen.description: true reopens a closed board (default false = close)

name: close_leaderboard
